searchText: fixed - thanks! What if node operators in mass get sued for the blocks they create and transactions that occured in them? Shouldn't the network be protecting its components? (And in this case we have a real world situation we're dealing with that butta likely is too) Not really. There are efforts underway for US operators, and all guidance received will no doubt be shared more widely. So far, OFAC has been purposefully obscure. And that lack of clarity is clarity in and of itself: If the guidance was "you better not include those tx in your blocks", they would have just said so. And yes that'd have been all over the crypto and possibly mainstream news shortly. They didn't say that. They refuse to say either way. Maybe they're waiting for a consensus to emerge that they like. So in the meantime: Keep on trucking.
